## Webinar series

The NBA Webinar Series showcases presentations and discussions related to South Africa’s 2025 National Biodiversity Assessment. These webinars unpack key findings, highlight species trends and recovery actions, and explore how assessment results inform policy, planning and conservation practice. The series forms part of SANBI’s efforts to translate biodiversity assessments into meaningful action.

For more information about upcoming webinars see [here](https://www.sanbi.org/news/nba-webinar-series-begins-with-overview-of-key-findings/).

Links to recordings of completed webinars:

**Webinar 1:** [Reverse the Red: NBA 2025 species findings](https://youtu.be/m6NkcfjvR-o)

**Webinar 2**: [Reverse the Red: Species recovery in freshwater and marine ecosystems](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ob7svDrhbxc&t)
